transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As part of our normal pre-settlement control meeting, I need to review a proposed collateral substitution. We currently have $6,000,000 outstanding under the central-bank liquidity facility, with $10,000,000 in government bonds pledged as collateral. The facility requires collateral valued at least 1.25 times the outstanding borrowing, so we're well above the minimum right now. The proposal is to replace part of the government-bond collateral with investment-grade corporate bonds, freeing up some government bonds to support an upcoming client settlement. Before I sign off on this, I'd like each of you — collateral risk, legal, treasury operations, and relationship coverage — to report any relevant requirements or concerns you have. Let's start with collateral risk.
